parrafo.es: In The Cape Electric es un contratista eléctrico de Cape Coral que atiende casas, muelles y negocios en el suroeste de Florida. Dan y su equipo llegan rápido, tramitan el permiso cuando hace falta y explican el trabajo antes de empezar.
parrafo.en: In The Cape Electric is a Cape Coral electrical contractor serving homes, docks and businesses across Southwest Florida. Dan and the crew show up fast, pull the permit when one is needed, and walk you through the job before it starts.

parrafo_1.es: In The Cape Electric es un contratista eléctrico que atiende Cape Coral y el suroeste de Florida, desde actualizaciones de panel y generadores hasta trabajo eléctrico en muelles y espacios comerciales.
parrafo_1.en: In The Cape Electric is an electrical contractor serving Cape Coral and Southwest Florida, from panel upgrades and generator hookups to dock and commercial electrical work.

parrafo_2.es: Las reseñas de Google repiten lo mismo: respuesta rápida, precios claros desde el inicio y trabajo terminado a tiempo. En una emergencia eléctrica en feriado, el equipo gestionó el permiso de emergencia y no dejó el trabajo a medias.
parrafo_2.en: Clients on Google keep saying the same thing: fast response, upfront pricing and work finished on time. During a holiday electrical emergency, the team pulled the emergency permit and stayed with the job until it was done.

texto.es: Cuéntanos qué pasa: un panel, un generador, un apagón o una reparación general.
texto.en: Tell us what's going on: a panel, a generator, a dead circuit or a general repair.

texto.es: El equipo revisa el problema y te da un precio claro antes de tocar nada.
texto.en: The team checks the problem and gives you a clear price before touching anything.

texto.es: Si el trabajo necesita permiso, lo tramitan ellos mismos, incluso en emergencias.
texto.en: If the job needs a permit, they pull it themselves, even on an emergency.

texto.es: Antes de irse, prueban el trabajo y te explican qué quedó hecho.
texto.en: Before leaving, they test the work and walk you through what was done.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza según el alcance. Llama y te damos el precio sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on the scope of work. Call and we will give you a price, no obligation.

texto.es: Actualización e instalación de paneles y desconectadores, residenciales y comerciales, con el cableado ordenado como el que ves en nuestras fotos.
texto.en: Panel and disconnect upgrades and installs, residential and commercial, with the clean wiring you can see in our photos.

texto.es: Conexión de generador (back feed), interruptores de transferencia y circuitos adicionales para que no te quedes sin luz.
texto.en: Generator back feed connections, transfer switches and additional circuits so you are never left without power.

texto.es: Breakers que saltan, circuitos sin corriente, recableado de baños y cuartos. Se resuelve rápido y se explica la causa.
texto.en: Tripping breakers, dead circuits, bathroom and room rewiring. Fixed fast, with the cause explained.

texto.es: Instalaciones eléctricas en muelles y elevadores de botes, iluminación industrial y tableros para negocios y bodegas.
texto.en: Electrical installs for docks and boat lifts, industrial lighting and switchgear for businesses and warehouses.

pie.es: ¿No ves tu proyecto en la lista? Llama igual, seguro lo cubrimos.
pie.en: Do not see your project listed? Call anyway, we likely cover it.

items.quote: We had a major electrical emergency on a holiday. This company agreed to do the work and it was completed in a timely manner. The owner secured the emergency permit and worked for hours trying to get the power company to do their part. All is well now and we are grateful for Mike's professionalism and determination.
ITC (In The Cape Electric) added a generator back feed and additional 20amp circuit for us. Great price. Excellent and efficient job. I highly recommend Dan and his crew!
Highly recommend! Needed some electrical installed at our dock and Dan was very professional from start to finish. Upfront reasonable pricing and was able to complete the job quickly. Thanks again!
They are great. Rewired my bathroom and trouble shooted a faulty breaker in my barn. They came out asap as my horses had no cooling fans in this heat. Highly recommend!!!! Thank you guys!
